headline: Exchange Intake Flips To A 110.5 Million Dollar Outflow, Led By A 416.7 Million Dollar Binance Outflow
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues flipped to a 110.5 million dollar outflow, 0.0405 percent of the 272.9 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from a 1,029.9 million dollar intake in the prior reading. Binance posted a 416.7 million dollar outflow after an 836.1 million dollar intake, while OKX took in 214.3 million dollars, up from 190.6 million dollars, and Gate took in 165.5 million dollars, down from 176.8 million dollars. The pipe measures the 24-hour change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the negative total means more clean-asset value left than arrived, and Binance was the largest departure.
author: jordan
